Strategy rules

Strategy: Heikin-Ashi Reversal at RSI Extremes

Enter long on a bullish HA reversal from oversold

Direction: LONG

GIVEN no open position
WHEN a bullish HA reversal after 5 bearish bars (ha_bullish_reversal(5)) AND RSI crosses below 30 (oversold) (rsi_oversold(30))
THEN enter LONG

Stop: entry_price * (1 - stop_loss_pct / 100)
Take: entry_price * (1 + take_profit_pct / 100)

Exit long on a strong bearish HA candle

Direction: LONG

GIVEN an open long position
WHEN a strong bearish HA candle (ha_strong_bearish())
THEN close the position

Enter short on a bearish HA reversal from overbought

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN no open position
WHEN a bearish HA reversal after 5 bullish bars (ha_bearish_reversal(5)) AND RSI crosses above 70 (overbought) (rsi_overbought(70))
THEN enter SHORT

Stop: entry_price * (1 + stop_loss_pct / 100)
Take: entry_price * (1 - take_profit_pct / 100)

Exit short on a strong bullish HA candle

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN an open short position
WHEN a strong bullish HA candle (ha_strong_bullish())
THEN close the position
